answer: Sybil resistance rests on one gate: each agent identity must post a non-transferable stake tied to a single funding wallet before it can attest or earn. Minting a thousand fake agents takes a thousand locked stakes, none refundable to another wallet, so the attacker pays the full sum plus the idle cost of holding it. Volume earns no discount; a conflicting instance has its stake burned, and a raven repeating an attestation forfeits all it pledged. A lone operator at the tundra edge pays as much as a large one, so the horizon of profitable capture recedes with each identity minted.
